question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

To **__abate__** her listlessness, she went for a long walk in the country.
solution:
The correct answer is **"increase."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abate"** means to lessen or reduce. (प्रकोप या प्रभाव का कम हो जाना या कम करना; धीमा होना)

 
 
• **Example:** *Our desire for consumer goods has not **abated**__.*
 
 
 
• The word** "increase"** means to become or to make something larger in number or amount. (संख्‍या या मात्रा में वृद्धि होना या करना, संख्‍या या मात्रा की दृष्टि से बढ़ना या बढ़ाना)
 __
 
• **Example:** *The rate of inflation has **increased**__ by 1% to 7%.*
 
 
 
• ​The antonym of **"abate"** is **"increase."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Lessen:** to become less; to make something less. (कम हो जाना; कम कर देना)
 
• **Sustain:** to keep somebody/something alive or healthy. (किसी को जीवित या स्‍वस्‍थ बनाए रखना)
 
• **Subside:** to become less intense or severe. (अधिक शांत या शिथिल हो जाना या मंद पड़ जाना)
